notes: The second clause writes both neither and any: the waw takes the connective neither under rule 14's open list and the negative takes the determiner any under rule 15. Fusing waw and negative on neither, with any left to the noun under rule 35, was the competing reading (rule 8).

'Thou shalt have no inheritance' heads on inheritance because tinchal alone is the source of the whole light-verb phrase (rule 44); at vv.23-24, where nachalah is written, the have goes to the verb under rule 43.
